incidents.name: BabySwap swap-fee parameter access control
incidents.notes: A privileged parameter setter on the BabySwap contract was reachable by any caller, letting the attacker reconfigure the swap/fee routing and drain the pool's USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x5c9f1A9CeD41cCC5DcecDa5AFC317b72f1e49636 created 2021-06-02T06:44:05Z by 0xc0a56aee755bd397235367008f7c2c4599768395, unrelated to attack sender 0x0000000038b8889b6ab9790e20fc16fdc5714922; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 65,055.71 USDT left 0xe730c7b7470447ad4886c763247012dfd233baff to the attack contract in the exploit transaction.
